description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between Reliability Score and Cost for three different modeling approaches: 3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. The x-axis is labeled "Cost" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Reliability Score" and uses a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The "3-Model Ensemble" is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, showing a slight, steady decline from a reliability score of approximately 82 at a cost of 0 to roughly 75 at a cost of 10. The "2-Model Ensemble" is depicted by a solid reddish-brown line with circular markers, which also exhibits a steady decline, starting at approximately 85 at a cost of 0, passing through a score of roughly 79 at a cost of 5, and ending at approximately 73 at a cost of 10. Finally, "GPT-4" is shown as a solid gold line with circular markers, displaying a steep, steady decline from a high score of approximately 89 at a cost of 0, dropping to roughly 65 at a cost of 5, and concluding at approximately 41 at a cost of 10.
